name: LAN Share
description: LAN peer presence and transfer via a vendored LocalSend helper (discovery plus text send plus incoming-file accept plus PC-to-phone file send via a zenity picker). Receiver stays OFF until enabled; the announced device name is configurable and defaults to the system hostname.
author: And0Null
permissions: Spawns the vendored LocalSend helper (modules/widgets/nearby/bin/narciss-lan-share-helper) as a receiver on TCP/UDP port 53317; zero LAN traffic while the receiver is OFF
Reads the device's own hostname to announce a default name other devices can see
Reads clipboard text via wl-paste and writes received text via wl-copy for text send
Saves accepted incoming files to ~/Downloads with a unique suffix on name collision
Sends desktop notifications via notify-send on transfer completion
Spawns zenity --file-selection --multiple for the Send files picker (PC to phone)
